name: wx-vsce-openai-compat-models
description: Register user-configured OpenAI-compatible chat models (Cloudflare Workers AI, vLLM, LiteLLM, Together, Groq, etc.) as language models that any LM-aware extension can call.

wxOpenAICompat.url.markdownDescription:
OpenAI-compatible base URL.

- For Cloudflare Workers AI: `https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/ai/v1`
- For self-hosted vLLM/LiteLLM: `https://your-host/v1`

If the URL ends in `/v\d+` (e.g. `/v1`, `/v2`), `/chat/completions` is appended. If the URL already contains `/chat/completions` or `/responses`, it is used as-is.

wxOpenAICompat.requestHeaders.markdownDescription: Additional HTTP headers to include with every request. Per-model `requestHeaders` override these. `Authorization` and `Content-Type` are always managed by the extension and cannot be overridden.

wxOpenAICompat.models.markdownDescription: List of models served by the configured endpoint. The API key is stored in VS Code's SecretStorage — set it with the `OpenAI Compatible: Set API Key` command.

id.description: Model identifier sent in the request body, e.g. "@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6".

name.description: Display name shown in the model picker. Defaults to id.

url.description: Per-model base URL override. If unset, the top-level url is used.

requestHeaders.description: Per-model HTTP headers, merged on top of wxOpenAICompat.requestHeaders.
